spec_match.rationale: Asks the three real surfaces relevant to a codec capability (canPlayType, MediaSource.isTypeSupported, decodingInfo for both media-source and file types) and explains why MSE is authoritative for IAMF per the chromestatus summary.

interactive.rationale: Preset select, free-text content-type field, and a button that fires all surfaces and renders each literal return value into its door panel.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises the literal per-surface answers and the MSE-vs-progressive distinction; the page delivers both plus an agreement verdict.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles missing MediaSource, missing mediaCapabilities, and decodingInfo rejections separately; a malformed preset (ec-3) is included; custom strings are supported.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus, the MSE spec isTypeSupported anchor, and MDN canPlayType.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's iamf-mse-surfaces-agree assertion pins the cross-door consistency contract this page demonstrates; suite passed 8/8 in the verification browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven headless Chromium 141: IAMF preset answered '' / false / supported:false on all doors with the agreement verdict rendered; AAC preset re-run via the select showed the field sync and fresh answers; console and network clean; desktop screenshot read.

telemetry_health.rationale: iamf-triptych-ran asserts a complete run, iamf-triptych-mse-doors-agree can genuinely fail on a divergent implementation, and the missing-mediaCapabilities branch asserts its own fallback id.

design_system.rationale: All colours from CSS variables; output panels use bg-stone with text-black (AA); the single button keeps the global dark style.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select and text input, output elements per door, and a role=status live region carrying the combined verdict; door outputs are marked aria-live=off so only the summary announces.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Doors stack via auto-fit minmax grid; emulated 360x740 DPR3 measurement shows scrollWidth 360 with the code-path pre scrolling internally; desktop verified via responsive-check.

openQuestions.title: Capture a real divergence example once IAMF ships
openQuestions.detail: On an IAMF-enabled build the interesting state (isTypeSupported true while canPlayType stays '') becomes observable. Record that run and consider quoting it in the page copy as a verified example instead of the current conditional phrasing.

guidanceConsulted.query: async feature detection status updates aria live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async results once via a polite live region rather than per-panel announcements; keep native form controls labelled.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Three door panels update silently (aria-live=off) and one role=status summary announces the combined verdict; select and input have explicit labels.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP run: status line renders combined verdict after both decodingInfo query types resolve

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive results table matrix mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use auto-fit minmax grids for panel rows so columns collapse on narrow viewports; keep wide code in scrollable pre blocks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The .doors grid uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) and collapses to one column at 360px; measured scrollWidth 360 with the pre scrolling internally.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP measurement: probe-surface-triptych scrollW=360 at 360x740 DPR3

summary: Config/inspection angle: one string, three real capability surfaces, literal answers side by side with an agreement verdict. Verified via CDP-driven headless Chromium 141 (sanctioned cloud fallback): both presets exercised through the real controls, honest all-negative IAMF answers with working baseline distinction, clean console/network, no mobile overflow.
